summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Voiladi offline features and Android APK (v1.1.0). All web offline functionality (banner, screen, 401 handling), native bridge integration (setToken/clearToken/ready), and APK structure validation passed successfully.
passed_tests: WEB: Offline banner appears/disappears correctly when navigator.onLine changes
WEB: Offline screen shown when token exists but /api/auth/me fails with network error (not 401)
WEB: Offline screen retry button works - removes blocking and loads content
WEB: 401 from /api/auth/me redirects to /welcome (not offline screen)
WEB: Native bridge window.VoiladiNative.ready() called on app load
WEB: Native bridge window.VoiladiNative.setToken() called on login with JWT
WEB: Native bridge window.VoiladiNative.clearToken() called on logout
WEB: Native bridge works in plain browser without errors (no-op when bridge not present)
WEB: All pages load without errors (discover, likes, chats, profile, notifications, welcome, signup)
WEB: No console errors during navigation
APK: Valid APK structure, package com.voiladi.app
APK: Version 1.1.0 (versionCode 2), minSdk 24, targetSdk 34
APK: MainActivity is main activity and exported
APK: All required permissions present (INTERNET, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, VIBRATE, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, CAMERA)
APK: PollService present with android.permission.BIND_JOB_SERVICE permission
APK: All required DEX classes present (MainActivity, PollService, Notifier, MainActivity$Bridge)
APK: All required DEX strings present (https://www.voiladi.com/, https://api.voiladi.com, VoiladiNative, voiladi)
APK: Resource 0x7f010000 -> ic_launcher.png (192x192 PNG)
APK: Resource 0x7f010001 -> ic_notification.png (96x96 PNG with transparency)
APK: resources.arsc stored (uncompressed) and 4-byte aligned
APK: Signing verified (v2 + v3 schemes)
APK: Rebuild successful with build_apk.py
